notes: New: Music has a real Now Playing screen now, like Radio/TV, with proper Previous/Next track buttons instead of the podcast-style 10/30-second skip controls it borrowed before. Improved: Auto EQ now applies a gentler version of whatever preset it picks automatically instead of full strength, and the update-download progress bar no longer sits frozen at 0% on phones where the total size takes a while to arrive. Fixed: installing an update no longer jumps straight to the system installer the instant the download finishes - there's now a 'Ready to install' step you tap through first.
